params.name: q
params.description: Free-text query over name and description (and tags where applicable).

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated tags to filter by. Tag names are Title Case (e.g. Messaging); lowercase slugs (e.g. messaging) are also accepted.

params.name: match
params.description: Whether results must match `any` (default) or `all` of the supplied tags.

params.name: artifact_types
params.description: Comma-separated artifact types. Filters which artifacts are returned and (on list endpoints) which APIs qualify.

params.name: industry
params.description: Filter by one or more industry slugs.

params.name: region
params.description: Filter by one or more region slugs.

params.name: band
params.description: Filter by one or more rating bands.

params.name: min_score
params.description: Minimum composite score (0–100).

params.name: max_score
params.description: Maximum composite score (0–100).

params.name: trend
params.description: Filter by trend marker.

params.name: facet
params.description: Facet to apply `min_facet` against.

params.name: min_facet
params.description: Minimum score (0–100) for the facet named by `facet`.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order.

params.name: fields
params.description: Sparse fieldset — comma-separated property names to return.

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number.

params.name: limit
params.description: Items per page.
